_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: A row turns bold, unread, only once its agent stops working in workspace mode. The server runs in workspace mode, with the conversation {{CONV_ID}}, which can message the user. Call "ready" has its agent message the user "Ready" and end its turn; call "delay" sends it a message its agent works on for 3 seconds. "The row" is ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"{{CONV_ID}}\"]", "the bold row" is ".conversation-item-unread[data-conversation-id=\"{{CONV_ID}}\"]", and "the title" is the row's ".conversation-title". On a fresh server the first load of a page takes a few seconds while the Assistant is created (the header title reads "Shelley" until then): wait for elements rather than reading the page right after navigating. On a phone-sized screen the drawer is off-canvas until the header's "Open tasks" button is clicked. To "open the drawer": click the button named exactly "Open tasks" if it is visible (on a phone it is whenever the drawer is closed: it is the header's top-left button; the drawer's own "Close tasks" button stays in the page while the drawer is off-canvas, so it says nothing about whether the drawer is open); the element with data-testid "assistant-row" should then be visible within the viewport. To "reload": the reload action. To "open the settings of" a project P: click "section[aria-label=\"P\"] a.project-select", then, in the element with data-testid "project-view", click the button named exactly "Settings" in its navigation (its <nav> element; click it even when its tab already shows); "the editor" is the region (role "region"; a <section> with that aria-label) named exactly "Edit project". To "edit project P" with a change: eval sessionStorage.setItem("editFrom", location.pathname) to remember the page; open the drawer; open the settings of P; make the change in the editor; click the editor's button named exactly "Save project"; the editor's text "Saved." should be visible; then return to the remembered page with a full load: eval (() => { window.__leaving = 1; location.assign(sessionStorage.getItem("editFrom")); return "leaving"; })(), expecting "leaving", then eval "window.__leaving === undefined && document.readyState === 'complete'" until it returns true. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /. 2. Open the drawer. 3. The row should be visible. 4. Call "ready". 5. The bold row should become visible. 6. The title's computed font-weight should be "700". 7. Call "delay". 8. The row's ".working-indicator" should become visible. 9. There should be exactly 0 bold rows. 10. The title's computed font-weight must not be "700". 11. The row should come to hold exactly 0 ".working-indicator" elements (allow up to 15s). 12. The bold row should be visible. 13. The title's computed font-weight should be "700". 14. Click the row. 15. The row should come to have aria-current "page". 16. There should be exactly 0 bold rows. 17. The title's computed font-weight must not be "700".
